_comment: L-edge / molecule-from-XYZ batch config. Both jobs below use the synthetic demo molecules bundled in examples/structures/ (idealized octahedral M(H2O)6, invented coordinates -- not real/published structures) and run out of the box with `generate`. Each job sets 'xyz_file' + 'edge' instead of 'structure_file' -- see fdmnes_pipeline/batch_config.py for the full schema. Duplicate a job and point xyz_file / filout / input_file at your own molecule and FDMNES working directory to adapt this for real use.
